messages:
ana: Drop a quick follow-up about rollback automation for compacting traces. We prototyped sidecar cohorting but need a deterministic fast rollback and forensic path for billing disputes. Thoughts?

priya: High level: we need 3 levers: feature-flag fast off, emergency full-rehydrate mode for a tenant, and post-hoc forensic restore (replay from cold store). Also alerts that trigger automatic mitigation.

mohit: Agree. Ops requirements: the toggle must be per-cluster and per-tenant. If billing mismatch > 0.5% for a tenant, we'd flip that tenant to full-fidelity for 24h automatically and kickoff a reconciliation job.

ana: Typo — ana :)

ana: thanks. More detail on triggers? We should avoid noisy flips. Propose multi-signal guard: (1) attribution_mismatch_rate > M1 for 3 consecutive 5m windows OR (2) billing_delta_absolute > $X for 1h OR (3) manual incident flag. When triggered: step1 auto-enable tenant_full=true, step2 enqueue recon job, step3 notify billing+account teams.

priya: Sounds good. Also add rolling back cohort aggressiveness globally: reduction factor by 50% for 10m before full-off, so we don't create an abrupt ingestion surge. e.g. via API: 
```
POST https://ops-api/flags/cohort_compact
{ "scope": "tenant:123|cluster:west-1", "action": "reduce_aggressiveness", "factor": 0.5, "duration_mins": 10 }
```

mohit: Forensic path: compact envelopes must keep provenance_token that is a pointer into raw cold-archive blobs (S3 key + small index). That lets us rehydrate exact traces for a tenant/time-range. Also keep a tiny reservoir of full traces for calibration.

priya: Security/compliance note: storing billing_key unhashed for rehydrate causes risk. For enterprise customers who require exact billing joins, we allow opt-in persistent keys behind KMS. Default remains hashed_billing_key + confidence bands. Document this clearly.

ana: Monitoring + dashboards: add a "rollback_candidate" scoreboard: list tenants with recent mismatch events, current cohort aggressiveness, last rollback time, and expected rehydrate ETA. Also surface expected cost delta if we flip to full for N hours.

mohit: Reconciliation job sketch: read compacted records + provenance -> rehydrate raw traces -> recompute attribution -> emit corrected billing delta CSV and a confidence score. Make this idempotent and rate-limited.

priya: Edge-case: if provenance pointers missing (edge crashed mid-compact), we should fallback to reservoir extrapolation and mark as "partial_forensic" in audit log. That must be visible to support.

ops-bot: Created task OBS-3122: "rollback & forensic path for compacting traces" with subtasks: flag-api, recon-job, provenance-schema, console-scoreboard, legal-review. Assigned ana/priya/mohit.

ana: Testing plan: 1) shadow-run where we mark traces but ingest full payloads and run simulated rollback to validate recon-job output; 2) inject synthetic attribution mismatches and assert automated tenant flip happens; 3) run a load test for rehydrate to validate ETA and avoid thundering-herd.

mohit: For avoiding thundering-herd, recon-job should support rate-limit tokens and backpressure to S3. Also prefer batched rehydration windows for heavy tenants.

priya: UI affordances: add "Forensic restore" action on tenant billing page with estimated cost and ETA, plus audit trail lines (who triggered, why, before/after deltas).

ana: OK next steps: ana will update RFC with rollback playbook and provenance schema, priya will draft flag API and console mocks, mohit will prototype recon-job and rate-limit. We'll run shadow tests next week. Short and actionable. :thumbsup:
